messages:
Ravi (CSM): Quick heads-up — Orbitera renewal due Fri. They're asking for a 6-month bridge term to align with our Dedicated migration plan. Procurement prelim sent PO ORB-BRIDGE-06 but wants split invoices (EU entity + US entity) and KMS integration checklist attached.
Sofia (AM): Sales ok'd a 6mo bridge with a 5% concession. We need exec signoff to commit KMS work now.
Marta (Legal): KMS clause OK in principle. I'll add required language about key custody, audit logging, and rollback procedures; want exec review for anything bespoke.
Hank (Finance): We can issue split invoices but need exact billing entities + tax IDs. Can't finalize without that. Also confirm terms: US Net30, EU Net45?
Ravi (CSM): Procurement replied in thread: will provide VAT ID and EIN by EOD. They asked whether a single PO can reference both billing entities or if we need two separate POs.
Lena (Solutions): For KMS/HSM we estimate ~3 weeks after sign to finish onboarding for private deployment. For the bridge term we could offer a cloud-managed key workaround, but that requires product/exec approval.
Sofia (AM): Execs usually resist temporary key workarounds. I'll tag for approval. If exec signoff doesn't arrive, customer might stall migration.
Marta (Legal): I'll draft a 6mo addendum that includes: prorate details, "no auto-renew", and a KMS onboarding opt-in clause. If procurement redlines split-invoice language, send it to me.
Hank (Finance): If we do two invoices, they must be separate invoice numbers and payment instructions. Also need to know which legal entity will accept liability.
Ravi (CSM): Customer requested enablement within 5 business days of sign (condensed onboarding). Can we prepare the agenda in parallel?
Lena (Solutions): Yes — we can prep a condensed 3-hour workshop and sanitized ROI slides while docs are finalized.
DocuSign-bot: Envelope env_orbit_6m created and sent to procurement@orbitera.com (status: sent).
ExecSign-bot: Exec approval requested: @CEO @CTO for KMS exception in addendum.
Sofia (AM): I'll escalate to CEO and CTO now. If approvals take >48h, proposal: sign the bridge without KMS and start non-KMS onboarding to keep momentum.
Ravi (CSM): Renewal tracker updated: status=waiting_on_signature_and_billing_details, risk=high, notes=6mo bridge for Dedicated migration; split invoices requested; KMS onboarding clause under negotiation.
Marta (Legal): Acknowledged. I'll stand by for procurement redlines and will respond quickly.
Hank (Finance): Once we receive the billing entity mapping (VAT/EIN) I'll prepare draft invoices.
Ravi (CSM): I'll follow up with procurement in 2 hours and update here. /cc @Sofia (AM) @Marta (Legal) @Hank (Finance) @Lena (Solutions)
